KZG.CommitmentScheme.binding_reduces_to_.type:
∀ {p : outParam ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {G₁ : Type} [inst : Group G₁] [inst_1 : PrimeOrderWith G₁ p] {G₂ : Type}
  [inst_2 : Group G₂] [inst_3 : PrimeOrderWith G₂ p] {Gₜ : Type} [inst_4 : Group Gₜ] [inst_5 : PrimeOrderWith Gₜ p]
  [inst_6 : DecidableEq Gₜ] [inst_7 : Module (ZMod p) (Additive G₁)] [inst_8 : Module (ZMod p) (Additive G₂)]
  [inst_9 : Module (ZMod p) (Additive Gₜ)] (pairing : Additive G₁ →ₗ[ZMod p] Additive G₂ →ₗ[ZMod p] Additive Gₜ) {n : ℕ}
  {g₁ : G₁} {g₂ : G₂},
  g₁ ≠ 1 →
    (pairing g₁) g₂ ≠ 0 →
      ∀ [SampleableType G₁] (AuxState : Type)
        (adversary : KZG.CommitmentScheme.KzgBindingAdversary p G₁ G₂ n unifSpec AuxState),
        Commitment.bindingExperiment (pure ∅) (unifFwdImpl unifSpec) (KZG.CommitmentScheme.kzg pairing) AuxState
            adversary ≤
          Groups.tSdhExperiment n (KZG.CommitmentScheme.bindingReduction pairing AuxState adversary)
KZG.CommitmentScheme.binding_reduces_to_.docstring:
**Extraction-shaped evaluation binding for KZG.** Every evaluation-binding adversary
`adversary` *yields*, as explicit data — the reduction `bindingReduction … adversary` — a
`t`-SDH adversary whose success probability upper-bounds `adversary`'s binding advantage.

This is the full constructive content of `binding`, stated *without* the
universally-quantified `Groups.tSdhAssumption` hypothesis. It is therefore immune to the
fact that `tSdhAssumption … error` is false below error `1` for an unrestricted adversary
class (a `Classical.choice` adversary can read the trapdoor out of the verifier SRS leg):
there is no assumption `Prop` here for such an adversary to inhabit. The bound relates two
concrete probabilities of *this* adversary and *its* reduction. It is a genuine reduction
statement at every parameter, although the right-hand probability may of course be large for a
particular adversary. `binding` below is the immediate corollary obtained by bounding the
reduction's own success probability via the assumption.

KZG.CommitmentScheme.bindingReduction.value:
fun {p} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {G₁} [Group G₁] [PrimeOrderWith G₁ p] {g₁} {G₂} [Group G₂] [PrimeOrderWith G₂ p] {g₂} {Gₜ}
    [Group Gₜ] [PrimeOrderWith Gₜ p] [DecidableEq Gₜ] [Module (ZMod p) (Additive G₁)] [Module (ZMod p) (Additive G₂)]
    [Module (ZMod p) (Additive Gₜ)] pairing {n} AuxState adversary srs =>
  simulateQ ((unifFwdImpl unifSpec).addLift ProtocolSpec.challengeQueryImpl)
    (match (srs, srs) with
    | (ck, vk) => do
      let __x ←
        (adversary.claim ck).liftComp (unifSpec + [{ dir := !v[Direction.P_to_V], «Type» := !v[G₁] }.Challenge]ₒ)
      match __x with
        | (cm, ⟨query, (resp₁, resp₂, st₁, st₂)⟩) =>
          have reduction :=
            { prover := adversary.prover ck,
              verifier := ((KZG.CommitmentScheme.kzg pairing).opening (ck, vk)).verifier };
          do
          let result₁ ← (Reduction.run (cm, ⟨query, resp₁⟩) st₁ reduction).run
          let result₂ ← (Reduction.run (cm, ⟨query, resp₂⟩) st₂ reduction).run
          have accept₁ : Bool := (Option.map (fun result => result.2) result₁).getD false
          have accept₂ : Bool := (Option.map (fun result => result.2) result₂).getD false
          have proof₁ : G₁ := (Option.map (fun result => result.1.1 0) result₁).getD 1
          have proof₂ : G₁ := (Option.map (fun result => result.1.1 0) result₂).getD 1
          pure
              (some
                (KZG.CommitmentScheme.mapBindingInstanceToTsdh
                  (srs, cm, query, resp₁, resp₂, accept₁, accept₂, proof₁, proof₂))))

Commitment.bindingGame.value:
fun {ι} {oSpec} {Data} [OracleInterface Data] {Commitment Decommitment ComKey VerifKey} {n} {pSpec}
    [(i : pSpec.ChallengeIdx) → SampleableType (pSpec.Challenge i)] {σ} init impl scheme AuxState adversary =>
  have pImpl := impl.addLift ProtocolSpec.challengeQueryImpl;
  OptionT.mk do
    let s ← init
    let __x ← (simulateQ impl scheme.keygen).run s
    match __x with
      | ((ck, vk), sAfterSetup) =>
        (simulateQ pImpl
              (have this := do
                let __x ← (adversary.claim ck).liftComp (oSpec + [pSpec.Challenge]ₒ)
                match __x with
                  | (cm, ⟨query, (resp₁, resp₂, st₁, st₂)⟩) =>
                    have reduction := { prover := adversary.prover ck, verifier := (scheme.opening (ck, vk)).verifier };
                    do
                    let __do_lift ← (Reduction.verdict (cm, ⟨query, resp₁⟩) st₁ reduction).run
                    have accept₁ : Bool := __do_lift.getD false
                    let __do_lift ← (Reduction.verdict (cm, ⟨query, resp₂⟩) st₂ reduction).run
                    have accept₂ : Bool := __do_lift.getD false
                    pure (some ⟨query, (resp₁, resp₂, accept₁, accept₂)⟩);
              this)).run'
          sAfterSetup

Groups.tSdhGame.value:
fun {p} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {G₁} [Group G₁] {G₂} [Group G₂] [(i : ℕ) → SampleableType (unifSpec.Range i)] {g₁} {g₂} D
    adversary =>
  OptionT.mk do
    let τ ← Groups.sampleNonzeroZMod
    have srs : Vector G₁ (D + 1) × Vector G₂ 2 := Groups.PowerSrs.generate D τ
    let result ← (adversary srs).run' ∅
    pure
        (Option.map
          (fun x =>
            match x with
            | (c, h) => (τ, c, h))
          result)

KZG.CommitmentScheme.mapBindingInstanceT.value:
fun {p} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {G₁} [Group G₁] {G₂} {n} val =>
  match val with
  | (fst, fst_1, query, resp₁, resp₂, fst_2, fst_3, proof₁, proof₂) =>
    (-query, (proof₁ / proof₂) ^ (1 / (resp₂ - resp₁)).val)
